title: Shortest Subarray to be Removed to Make Array Sorted
goal: Remove the shortest contiguous segment so the remaining array is nondecreasing.
strategy: Keep a sorted prefix and sorted suffix. Their boundary values must fit together; use two pointers to find the smallest gap between compatible prefix and suffix endpoints.

edgeCases: Already sorted values require no removal
A descending array keeps just one element
Equal boundary values allow a valid merge
